text.tspan: Bayer-Westphalian Campaign Management Platform — Backend UML Class Diagram
Java 21 Spring Boot modular monolith: REST Controllers → Services → Repositories → JPA Entities
• Controllers depend on services; services depend on repositories; repositories manage entities.
• CampaignService must validate recipients through EligibilityService before dispatch.
• AI recommendations are advisory and cannot bypass eligibility checks or compliance approval.
• CommunicationService uses EmailProvider and SmsProvider interfaces for external adapters.
• AuditService records sensitive user, role, consent, product, campaign, report, and AI actions.

User ↔ Role many-to-many • Customer ↔ ConsentRecord • Beneficiary links policyholder Customer to beneficiary Customer • ProductOwnership links Customer to Product • PaymentRecord links to ProductOwnership

Segment has SegmentCriteria • Campaign targets Segment, promotes Product, has CampaignRecipients • ContactEvent belongs to Customer/Campaign • CampaignMetric belongs to Campaign • ReportExport requested by User
Legend: dashed open arrow = dependency / uses; empty triangle = inheritance / implementation; entity rows state their superclass.
